description: A narrow hedge hunter with a broad brush tail. Forages near cover and bites only when provoked.
Broad paws, tufted ears and a short tail mark this solitary clearing hunter. Its heavy paw strike has a long recovery.
A low, broad-footed root digger. Holds its ground with a sideways claw strike when provoked.
A heavy quilled animal browsing exposed roots. Slow attacks and a tough coat reward a deliberate approach.
A long-legged grazer with a hanging mane and tail. Needs open grass and an escape lane; its tailhair binds fishing rods.
Thick fleece and curled horns distinguish this broad sheep from ibex. A slow planted ram protects its grazing shelf.
A high-shouldered marsh browser with palmate antlers and a hanging throat bell. Needs broad dry banks and room to turn.
A smooth-backed forest browser with a short flexible snout. Keeps to sheltered dry ground beside the marsh.
A long flat-jawed bank predator with a heavy tail. Basks on dry ground and answers provocation with one weighty bite.
A small-headed crawler sheltering beneath warm damp stone. Its flexible body recoils behind a quick jaw strike.
A domed shell carries this slow ledge browser. Its beak reaches out between long rests; magic gets through its armor more easily.
A raised long-necked lizard with a whip tail and spread claws. Patrols dry scree and snaps more often than the crocodile.
A long-necked broad-billed bird on the dry reed margin. Spreads its wings and pecks when provoked.
A narrow reed hunter with long legs and a spear bill. Stands between deliberate steps on a dry bank.
A tall deep-chested ground bird ranging the open shelves. Displays before closing with fast light blows.
A broad fan-tailed bird with a bare neck and hanging wattle. Struts around its feeding yard and pecks back when attacked.
A spiral-shelled crawler on damp stone. Its eye stalks retract while the shell remains rigid.
Six planted legs brace a compact shell and branching mandibles. Its slow clamp leaves a long recovery.
Paired legs travel in a wave beneath linked armored segments. The forward jaws strike while the body remains on its ground route.
Eight legs surround a narrow waist and broad abdomen. A short-range root hunter with quick fang strikes.
A plated insectoid biped with heavy clawed forearms. Ranges abandoned kiln courts and commits to a slow powerful strike.
A squat armored drake with dorsal plates and a heavy horned head. Holds an outer quarry bench rather than chasing far.
A tall thin-winged insectoid walking on long jointed legs. Quick raptorial claws make it dangerous in sheltered ravines.
A lean raised ground dragon with long clawed legs, a horned head and a thin tail. Keeps to broad abandoned cuts.
A low grassland snake. Strikes when disturbed and lets passing travelers through.
A small moss-green winged predator guarding scrub away from the farm.
A tiny dusty-brown wasp sheltering in dry scrub. Attacks with a short stinger strike.
A small slate-blue wasp with quiet translucent wings and a sharp sting.
A small armored bank scavenger. Holds its ground when attacked.
A low bramble hunter. Short-range aggression and a quick mandible strike.
A small scavenger around abandoned supplies. Retaliates with a bite.
A dark red worm nosing through the grass outside Coldbrace.
Lilac dusk fur marks this shy hedge spirit.
A jade woodland spider with a faintly luminous shell.
An ice-blue shell protects this slow highland browser.
A copper crawler whose skin glows like cooling embers.
A violet cave hunter with a mineral sheen.
A broad, low stone guardian with weathered chalk plates and a deliberate hammering gait.
A leafless, petrified forest guardian. Its split trunk bends forward before a sweeping root-arm strike.
A hollow shroud drifting above the graves. Its hem and outstretched hands move without a walking step.
A bowed, hollow trunk carried by root hands. Its shoulder roots turn inward around a dark body cavity, and its heavy arms sweep low across the forest floor.
An eight-legged fen scavenger under a broad, overlapping carapace. Curved feeding blades frame a recessed mouth beneath its low front shield.
A six-legged wetland mimic with a raised reed-thin body, folded walking limbs, tapered abdomen and a long split feeding mask.
A rooted biped whose upper body is a split seedpod. Thick wooden jaw valves hinge around a hollow mouth while its heavy forearms drive a close crushing strike.
A long-armed heath scavenger in worn cloth. Its hollow carved face has open eye slits and a downturned cambium nose; its hands and knife move with quick, narrow cuts.
A hunched stone giant with long, heavy arms. Banked heat shows through narrow cracks in its cooled ash hide.
An eight-legged furnace scavenger with overlapping slag plates, a shovel mouth and folding mandibles. Its body rocks over a low, heavy support gait.
An apparition in a pale ash cowl and scorched maroon robes. A dark face slit sits above its long reaching hands.
A crouched corpse with cold pale skin and torn dark clothing. Its long arms hang beside a lean, hunched torso as it searches the graves.
A hooded apparition in worn ceremonial cloth. Long sleeves follow its hooked hands through a sweeping strike.
A low, weathered slab creature with a recessed head and heavy hammer forearms. It transfers its weight before striking.
A stone burrower with a flattened shovel cranium and wide digging claws. Its upper body sweeps sideways while its feet brace.
A walking remnant of a sealed vault. Its hollow masonry chest and massive lintel arms close around intruders.
An eyeless cave hunter with a cleft abdomen, a low sensory hood and long searching forelegs. It feels for movement before lunging.
An eroded stone effigy with tapered stilt legs, a closed split hood and flat forearms. It turns its torso to listen across the scree.
A red hatchling with a broad brow, short tail and developing wing fingers. It braces on its rear claws before snapping forward.
A low black hatchling with a short hooked muzzle, round throat and broad small wings. It stalks the charcoal flats.
A lean volcanic dreadwing with a tucked throat, long tail and copper-red hide above an ochre underside.
A tall red wyvern with a spear-shaped skull, hooked wing claws and a long blade tail. Its rear legs brace a heavy neck strike.
A black four-legged dragon with a long low neck, backward crown horns and broad sail wings.
A narrow-bodied dreadwing with a raised throat, long legs and a swept tail. Pale horns break up its plum hide and violet wing membranes.
A lean purple dragon with a long neck and dark sail wings. Fine amethyst light follows the grain of its scales.
A low eight-legged furnace scavenger. Its split basalt mantle exposes molten seams between load-bearing plates.
A low, horned grazer with heavy claws, overlapping scales and a pale folded throat. It lowers its head before charging.
A lean horned predator with ochre plates over dark hide. Long hooked claws and powerful hind legs carry it across the basalt wastes.
An angular deep-earth crawler with separated upright plates. Blue and violet fissures show through the gaps as its mantle twists.
A tall stone guardian with worn slate armour over a darker jointed body. Faint violet eyes sit beneath its heavy brow.
A slender apparition in worn ash cloth and dark plum sleeves. Its hollow cowl and hooked hands lead a pulling spectral strike.
An ancient skeletal guard in a blackened helmet, carrying a sword and shield. Pale ribs and long bony limbs show beneath its equipment.
A broad stone sovereign with molten seams running through its dark hide. It bends at the waist to bring both heavy arms into a crushing strike.
A hooded spectral jailer in worn ceremonial robes. Its long sleeves trail behind outstretched hands during a curse.
An armoured guardian with fitted plate, articulated gauntlets and a closed helm. Its heavy shoulders turn into each strike.
A winged deep-earth hunter with layered chitin, long antennae and hooked claws. Folded membranes rise behind its shoulders as it reaches for its prey.
A knight in pearl-white plate and a closed silver helm. Cool light catches the fitted armour above dark articulated joints.
A towering castle guardian in white plate, with pale gold shoulders and a shimmering silver helm. Its heavy gauntlets lead each strike.
A pale silver-antlered deer browsing the old royal parkland. Its cream coat has the faint green sheen of the surrounding groves.
An old walking tree with silver bark and dark moss-green hollows. Heavy root hands drag beside its bowed trunk.
A small winged garden spirit with a teal body and translucent lilac wings. Soft mint light gathers on its existing shell markings.
A small carved woodland hunter in plum cloth. Pale turquoise grain follows its long hands and hollow wooden face.
A low teal crawler with lilac shell edges and long folded legs. Its feeding blades shine like wet glass beneath the front shield.
An ancient violet tree guardian with teal inner growth and pale rose edges. A recessed luminous heart sits inside the split trunk.
A large violet-winged garden spirit with a deep turquoise shell. Magenta and cyan marks trace its familiar winged insect body.
A drifting figure in orchid-purple woven robes and an ivory cowl. Teal light runs softly across its outstretched hands.
A mature walking root with dark violet bark and bright turquoise inner fibres. Its crooked branches frame a deep shadowed body cavity.
A tall winged chitin sovereign with amethyst plates, wine-purple membranes and a pale teal sheen. Long antennae and hooked claws retain its ancient insect silhouette.
A young red dragon nesting beyond the royal patrols. Its short wings spread as it braces for a snapping strike.
A young black dragon with a hooked muzzle and broad small wings. It guards its patch of old kingdom pasture.
An adult red dragon that has claimed a hunting ground in the old kingdom. Its tall neck, wing claws and long blade tail rise above the young dragons.

A rotund garden sprite with curling tail, stone buds and winding markings across its back.
A staff-carrying woodland fey with spore-dappled skin and fungal markings on its robes.
A jewel-coloured frog resting in the damp shade of the gardens.
A small, one-eyed winged imp with pale membranes and curling horns.
A slow garden snail carrying a lilac spiral shell.
A squat one-eyed construct with moss-veined porcelain plates and gilded vine inlays.
A pale woodland hart with silver antlers and a cool sheen across its coat.
A hovering fey spirit wrapped in trailing veils sewn with branching veins and tiny stars.
A small walking tree with twisted root hands and light inside its bark.
A young fairy drake with flower-coloured scales and broad folded wings.
A compact guardian made of separated, floating stones around a luminous mineral core.
A small enchanted suit of armor with leaf-etched enamel, a gemstone shield and a narrow blade.

description: A storm scarab with swept carapace shields, a crescent shovel cranium and inward-cutting stone mandibles.
A wind-stripped elder with a split timber mantle, one heavy root forearm and a hollow wind-cut head.
A walking cathedral tree with a split hollow trunk, load-bearing bough arches and a recessed heart chamber.
A mature seed predator with interlocking woody pod valves, thick shoulder pods and an articulated root jaw.
A wave-eroded shore colossus with a low layered shell and an enormous split crushing claw.
A quarry fortress with twin open stone vaults, a slotted gate head, broken lintel shoulders and masonry crushing fists.
A furnace tyrant with a fused slag mantle, open barred chest, recessed iron face and asymmetric hammer arm.
